SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT record.id AS id, record.filing_no AS business_id, '设备建档' AS process_name, record.create_user AS create_user, record.process_ins_id AS process_id, record.process_status AS process_status, record.create_time AS create_time, CONCAT(record.device_num, record.unit_name, record.device_type_name) AS description FROM idevelop_device_record record WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND record.STATUS < 3 UNION ALL SELECT transfer.id AS id, transfer.filing_no AS business_id, '设备转资' AS process_name, transfer.create_user AS create_user, transfer.process_ins_id AS process_id, transfer.process_status AS process_status, transfer.create_time AS create_time, '' AS description FROM idevelop_device_transfer transfer WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND transfer.STATUS < 3 UNION ALL SELECT apply.id AS id, apply.apply_no AS business_id, '设备申请' AS process_name, apply.create_user AS create_user, apply.process_ins_id AS process_id, apply.process_status AS process_status, apply.create_time AS create_time, apply.apply_reason AS description FROM idevelop_device_apply apply WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND apply.STATUS < 6 UNION ALL SELECT outbound.id AS id, outbound.outbound_no AS business_id, '设备出库' AS process_name, outbound.create_user AS create_user, outbound.process_ins_id AS process_id, outbound.process_status AS process_status, outbound.create_time AS create_time, CONCAT('申请数量: ', outbound.apply_num, ' ', '出库数量: ', outbound.outbound_num) AS description FROM idevelop_device_outbound outbound WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND outbound.STATUS < 5 UNION ALL SELECT operation.id AS id, operation.operation_no AS business_id, '设备投运' AS process_name, operation.create_user AS create_user, operation.process_ins_id AS process_id, operation.process_status AS process_status, operation.create_time AS create_time, CONCAT(operation.device_type_name, operation.operation_num) AS description FROM idevelop_device_operation operation WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND operation_type = 0 AND operation.STATUS < 6 UNION ALL SELECT scrap.id AS id, scrap.filing_no AS business_id, '设备报废' AS process_name, scrap.create_user AS create_user, scrap.process_ins_id AS process_id, scrap.process_status AS process_status, scrap.create_time AS create_time, CONCAT(scrap.scrap_reason, scrap.device_num) AS description FROM idevelop_device_scrap scrap WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND scrap.STATUS < 3 UNION ALL SELECT repairs.id AS id, repairs.filing_no AS business_id, '设备报修' AS process_name, repairs.create_user AS create_user, repairs.process_ins_id AS process_id, repairs.process_status AS process_status, repairs.create_time AS create_time, CONCAT(repairs.repair_type, repairs.description) AS description FROM idevelop_device_repair repairs WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND repairs.ticket_status < 6 UNION ALL SELECT returned.id AS id, returned.filing_no AS business_id, '设备退运' AS process_name, returned.create_user AS create_user, returned.process_ins_id AS process_id, returned.process_status AS process_status, returned.create_time AS create_time, returned.return_reason AS description FROM idevelop_device_returned returned WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND returned.STATUS < 3 UNION ALL SELECT changes.id AS id, changes.filing_no AS business_id, '设备变更' AS process_name, changes.create_user AS create_user, changes.process_ins_id AS process_id, changes.process_status AS process_status, changes.create_time AS create_time, changes.change_type AS description FROM idevelop_device_change changes WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND changes.ticket_status < 3 UNION ALL SELECT t.id AS id, t.code AS business_id, t.type AS process_name, t.create_user, t.process_ins_id as process_id, t.process_code as process_status, t.initiateTime AS create_time, '' as description FROM ( SELECT id, `code`, '检修计划' AS type, status_info, create_time AS initiateTime, create_user, process_ins_id, 'nanrui_jihua' AS process_code, is_deleted FROM info_repair_plan WHERE is_deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT id, `code`, '检修工单' AS type, status_info, create_time AS initiateTime, create_user, process_ins_id, 'nanrui_jxgd' AS process_code, is_deleted FROM info_repair WHERE is_deleted = 0 ) t
WHERE t.is_deleted = 0 AND status_info = 2 ) works
works.create_user = #{createUser}
ORDER BY works.create_time DESC
